title: Psalms Bible Quiz - Chapter 82
description: Ten questions on Psalms 82: God judges among the gods and calls for justice for the weak, the poor and the fatherless.

questions.text: Where does God preside, according to verse 1?
questions.explanation: Verse 1 says God presides in the great assembly.

questions.text: Among whom does God judge in verse 1?
questions.explanation: Verse 1 says: "He judges among the gods."

questions.text: In verse 2, what are the judges accused of showing to the wicked?
questions.explanation: Verse 2 asks how long they will judge unjustly and show partiality to the wicked.

questions.text: Whom are they told to defend in verse 3?
questions.explanation: Verse 3 says: "Defend the weak, the poor, and the fatherless."

answers.text: The kings, the priests, and the elders
The rich, the strong, and the mighty
The weak, the poor, and the fatherless
The soldiers, the guards, and the scribes

questions.text: Out of whose hand are the weak and needy to be delivered?
questions.explanation: Verse 4 says to rescue the weak and needy and deliver them out of the hand of the wicked.

questions.text: Where do "they" walk back and forth in verse 5?
questions.explanation: Verse 5 says they don't know or understand, and they walk back and forth in darkness.

answers.text: In the courts of the king

questions.text: What does verse 5 say is shaken?
questions.explanation: Verse 5 says all the foundations of the earth are shaken.

answers.text: All the foundations of the earth

questions.text: In verse 6, whose sons are they all called?
questions.explanation: Verse 6 says: "You are gods, all of you are sons of the Most High."

questions.text: According to verse 7, they will die like men and fall like one of whom?
questions.explanation: Verse 7 says they shall die like men, and fall like one of the rulers.

questions.text: What reason does verse 8 give when it asks God to arise and judge the earth?
questions.explanation: Verse 8 says: "Arise, God, judge the earth, for you inherit all of the nations."

answers.text: He dwells on the holy mountain of Zion
He made the sea and the dry land
He rides upon the clouds of heaven
He inherits all of the nations
